name: crucible
description: Keep your craft sharp: doc-discipline (cms — frontmatter linting, ADR scaffolding, drift detection, staleness archival, a generated HTML view of any document with diagrams, and a multi-repo documentation site built from the markdown already in the repos, where a page exists if its sources exist), a sparring partner for an idea you are still forming (spar-with-me: mandatory internal + web research, an honest take that moves only on new evidence, and a strictly read-only session), adversarial stress-testing once that idea hardens into a decision (grill-me), a structured development workflow (develop), a safe branch lifecycle (start-branch / finish-branch), skill-craft (author, distil and lint agent skills), eval-first development (freeze a baseline, gate on match-or-beat-or-revert), flag-gate (default-OFF rollout with instant revert), loop-harness (bounded, single-threaded, read-only agent loops with budget ceilings, a LOOP-STATE ledger, and a worktree-only safety hook), act-for-real (the discipline for irreversible actions on live systems you often don't own: classify reversibility, bind authority to the exact action, never fabricate a real-world identifier, verify from a fresh read instead of the call), and repo-audit (recurring whole-repo health audit: a deterministic metrics anchor plus four frozen read-only lenses, trended over time). It also carries refactor-audit (audit one change — a range, a branch or the working diff — for production-readiness, ranked and split into what an agent can fix unattended and what needs a human decision).
